sections.title: BarkLog kit · design 05
sections.intent: Mobbin-informed structure, original BarkLog art: editorial type, expressive care marks, colored feature folios, a living day line and informative logging. Inter 400/500, Firm controls, native-parity motion.

sections.title: Opening & guided first run
sections.intent: A six-second optional opening and name-only fast start, or a user-paced, skippable path: identity → shortcuts → practice → notes → Timeline → local storage → ready. No permissions or account gate.

sections.title: Name-only start
sections.intent: The existing fast path: enter the dog’s name, then open the local journal. No additional setup gate.

sections.title: Home · a day with your dog
sections.intent: Dog-first composition, four fast actions, a living day line, a complete log editor and notes. Proposed review direction; the October 14 native source stays pinned.

sections.title: Create a log · observations & notes
sections.intent: Nine expressive editors: key observations, generous notes, optional context, sample attachments, drafts, validation, saving and committed record detail.

sections.title: Timeline · approved + scope
sections.intent: Approved reading path and filters, extended with multi-dog scope and local-v1 event presentations.

sections.title: Record lifecycle
sections.intent: Approved detail, edit and confirmed deletion, plus retry and stale-revision handling.

sections.title: Profile & early Insights · approved
sections.intent: October 14 references kept intact for comparison; they do not claim later features are implemented.

sections.title: Profiles & settings
sections.intent: Dog switching, later details, local storage, accessibility and deliberate deletion with export available first.

sections.title: Medication & vaccination
sections.intent: Caregiver-entered plans and factual history. No calculator, recommendation or automatic permission prompt.

sections.title: Care calendar & reminders
sections.intent: Tasks save locally even when reminder permission is declined or scheduling fails.

sections.title: Insights & trends
sections.intent: Factual, accessible summaries with text equivalents. Missing observations never become health judgments.

sections.title: Offline Safety Center
sections.intent: Bounded emergency organization with visible source/version status. No diagnosis, dose or AI decision.

sections.title: Vet preparation & exports
sections.intent: Choose dog, date and content; preview; export CSV/PDF; then hand off to the real system share or print surface.

sections.title: Training
sections.intent: Short positive-reinforcement sessions; completion and Timeline save are one committed result.

sections.title: Photo journal & baselines
sections.intent: User-triggered native picker, local example photos and descriptive baselines without comparison claims.

sections.title: Expenses
sections.intent: Explicit date, currency and precision; receipts remain local attachments.

sections.title: Memory Book
sections.intent: Local highlights trace back to real example records or photos; no generated medical narrative.

sections.title: Global states
sections.intent: Content-shaped loading, calm recovery, offline reassurance, permission denial, conflicts and reduced-motion finals.

sections.title: Motion & continuity
sections.intent: Firm press/release and calm shared-element journeys. Reduced motion lands directly on the final state.

screens.name: Design 04 · observation, note, memory
screens.intent: Mobbin mechanics adapted to original BarkLog parts: dog scene, expressive choice, generous notes and purposeful motion.

screens.name: Visual language · warm, colorful, dog-first
screens.intent: Warm editorial colour, a recognizable dog portrait and flat layered shapes give BarkLog personality without decorative gradients or shadows.

screens.name: Type · Bricolage display, Inter reading
screens.intent: Design 06 proposal: Bricolage Grotesque 700/800 for headings and numbers, Inter 400/500 for reading. Display 44, screen 34, section 21, body 14–16, captions 11–13. Tabular numbers.

screens.name: Controls · default, disabled, error
screens.intent: Visible labels, native-like inputs, state-shaped loading and quiet secondary action.

screens.name: Firm · press release
screens.intent: Motion comparison. 0.86 damping. Content does not bounce. Proposed default: Firm.

screens.name: Bubbly · press release
screens.intent: Motion comparison. 0.62 damping. Content does not bounce. Proposed default: Firm.

screens.name: Lively · press release
screens.intent: Motion comparison. 0.55 damping. Content does not bounce. Proposed default: Firm.

screens.name: Parts · future feature rows
screens.intent: Reusable dog switcher, agenda row, status, attachment and money patterns; each remains readable without colour.

screens.name: Data views · chart plus words
screens.intent: Exact values, contextual scope and a text equivalent accompany every chart.

screens.name: Colour · named families, one action accent
screens.intent: Colour research translated into the original BarkLog palette. Every care type has a name and icon. Dedicated dark inks/backgrounds, no gradients or decorative shadows.

screens.name: System handoffs · labeled, never faked
screens.intent: Permissions, photo picking, sharing, printing, settings and calling remain honest platform boundaries.

screens.name: Press · calm content, firm control
screens.intent: 90 ms press to 0.97 / 1 pt. Release response 0.30 / damping 0.86. Reduced motion removes transform.

screens.name: Day line · the hero part
screens.intent: v3 proposal. One day from 06:00 to 24:00; each record sits at its time and close records stack in up to three lanes. Solid up to now, dashed after. Marks carry an icon and a type colour; the accessible label lists every record and time.

screens.name: Firm · a mark landing
screens.intent: Feel picker for the one lively moment: a care mark landing on the day line. Spring 0.3 / 0.86. Presses stay Firm (approved). Proposed default: Bubbly. Pick one.

screens.name: Bubbly · a mark landing
screens.intent: Feel picker for the one lively moment: a care mark landing on the day line. Spring 0.38 / 0.62. Presses stay Firm (approved). Proposed default: Bubbly. Pick one.

screens.name: Lively · a mark landing
screens.intent: Feel picker for the one lively moment: a care mark landing on the day line. Spring 0.45 / 0.55. Presses stay Firm (approved). Proposed default: Bubbly. Pick one.
